wholeTreeFingerprint.algorithm: Historical SHA-256 over sorted file hashes excluding generated dependency and build directories; the original command is unavailable.

copy.method: Complete archive-mode file copy with hidden files and committed build artifacts preserved

sourceComparison.result: The source and copied upstream trees have no file-content or tree-entry differences.
sourceComparison.method: Recursive diff plus archive-mode rsync dry-run with itemized changes

verification.manifestAlgorithm: Regular files beneath upstream are sorted by POSIX-relative path with LC_ALL=C. Each LF-terminated manifest line is lowercase SHA-256, two ASCII spaces, then the relative path.
